name: com.thegidocs/public-information
title: GIDocs Public Information
description: Read-only lookup of GIDocs services, providers, offices and accepted insurance.

tools.name: get_gidocs_public_pages
tools.description: Use this read-only tool to locate official GIDocs healthcare services, providers, contact information, and accepted-insurance pages. Returns a directory of public website links; it does not access patient records or schedule appointments.

tools.name: search_gidocs_public_content
tools.description: Use this read-only tool to find GIDocs content about digestive-health conditions or other topics covered by the public website. Accepts a 2-80 character query and returns matching public WordPress search results; it does not access private patient information.
